patch_notes:
🚀 NEW FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS:
• Global Voice Expansion: Added 5 new AI TTS languages (Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean).
• Smart Auto-Scan: AI now intelligently mutes itself during auto-scans if your 3D model hasn't visually changed, preventing voice spam.

🛠️ PERFORMANCE & BUG FIXES:
• Microphone Engine Rewrite: Fixed a critical Windows API bug causing duplicated 'ghost' microphones and broken regional characters.
• Performance Leap: Drastically reduced application startup time (implemented Lazy Loading for heavy ML models).
• UI Polish: Fixed real-time language switching for dynamic UI elements and clipboard toasts.
• Improved overall stability of the background TTS audio engine.
